sponsor_decisions.rationale: The report covers the latest execution of each of the five Story 3 tasks at Supervisor v16, Research v10 and Data Analysis v10. Only Supervisor was deployed, from the approved integration branch. No provisioning, permission grants, or specialist deployment. These Story 3 runs are not new Story 1/4 regression evidence.

sponsor_decisions.decision: One latest execution per task, including its actual failures and limitations
sponsor_decisions.rationale: This HTML binds only the five latest task executions in hosted-agents-poc-dev. Superseded executions are excluded. Current failed checks and unsuccessful capability outcomes remain visible; successful report generation is not full story acceptance.

traceability.requirement: AC1 - Separate conversations and application-owned mapping
traceability.summary: All 9 checks passed: distinct Research conversation, user-isolated Supervisor mapping, later mapping re-read and custom parent metadata link.
traceability.limitations: Creation and mapping writes are separate operations. Interrupted creation, cleanup and crash recovery were not tested. Custom metadata is not a native parent-child contract.
traceability.next_step: Add interruption/recovery tests before production use.

traceability.requirement: AC2 - Follow-up reuses independent Research history
traceability.summary: All 9 checks passed. Follow-up reused the mapped child, Research history grew from 2 to 4 items and recalled the code word without it being resent. A fresh Supervisor conversation had no mapping.
traceability.limitations: Synthetic single-operator test; recall is supported by item counts, not a standalone deterministic persistence guarantee. Crash recovery and distinct-user isolation were not tested.
traceability.next_step: Retain separate histories and test interruption/recovery.

traceability.requirement: AC3 - Ownership, user binding, access and correlation
traceability.summary: 13 checks passed and 1 failed. Original-user binding, custom correlation and application mapping guards passed. Seven of eight access cases matched expectations; the operator could list the Supervisor-created Research child (2 items) when denial was expected.
traceability.limitations: Operator had Foundry User, Owner and User Access Administrator roles; the cause of the allowed read is unproven. Forwarded call-context reads were allowed, not proof of least-privileged two-user isolation or downstream OBO. Application correlation is not distributed tracing.
traceability.next_step: Reproduce with least-privileged distinct users and confirm the conversation access contract without relabeling this failure.

traceability.requirement: AC4 - Shared-ID read, append and later hydration
traceability.status: Evaluation Met; shared-ID calls did not complete
traceability.summary: All 8 recording checks passed. Research calls using the Supervisor ID returned HTTP 404 not_found in both identity modes and in the same-principal operator control. No Research input/output was appended; later Supervisor inspection saw no added Research messages.
traceability.limitations: PASS means explicit outcomes were captured, not that shared history worked. The exact cause of the cross-endpoint 404 is unverified.
traceability.next_step: Use separate IDs; confirm cross-endpoint conversation scope with Microsoft.

traceability.requirement: AC5 - Result, placeholder or full-history delivery comparison
traceability.summary: All 6 recording checks passed. Separate variants delivered result or placeholder as selected. Both shared variants returned HTTP 404 and were classified as nothing (sub-agent call did not complete).
traceability.limitations: No shared full-history delivery demonstrated. Streaming, background delivery, Data Analysis file delivery and crash recovery were not tested.
traceability.next_step: Use explicit result/reference delivery with separate Research conversations.
